scheme_name: Jharkhand State Backward Classes Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
description:
The Jharkhand State Backward Classes Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme was launched in the year 2016. 

This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from backward classes in Jharkhand. 

The primary objective is to promote higher education among students belonging to backward classes. 

The scheme seeks to reduce the dropout rate among these students by providing them with necessary financial support. 

The government has set a measurable target of increasing enrollment in post-matric courses by 20 percent over the next five years. 

The scholarship covers various educational expenses including tuition fees, examination fees, and other related costs. 

Under this scheme, students are eligible for a scholarship amount ranging from INR 1,200 to INR 10,000 per annum. 

The exact amount depends on the type of course and the institution where the student is enrolled. 

For instance, students pursuing professional courses may receive higher amounts compared to those in general courses. 

The scholarship is specifically designed for students who have completed their matriculation. 

Eligible students must belong to the backward classes as defined by the Jharkhand government. 

The income limit for applicants is set at INR 2.5 lakh per annum for the family. 

This income criterion ensures that the benefits reach the economically weaker sections of the backward classes. 

Students must be residents of Jharkhand to qualify for this scholarship scheme. 

Additionally, applicants must have secured admission in a recognized post-matric institution. 

The application process is straightforward and can be completed online. 

Students need to visit the official website of the Jharkhand government’s scholarship portal. 

They must create an account and fill out the application form with accurate details. 

Required documents include a caste certificate, income certificate, and proof of admission to the institution. 

Students must also submit their academic records and bank account details for scholarship disbursement. 

Once the application is submitted, it undergoes verification by the concerned authorities. 

The timeline for application submission typically opens in the month of July each year. 

The last date for submission is usually in August, but this can vary each year. 

Students are advised to keep track of announcements on the official scholarship portal for specific dates. 

Disbursement of the scholarship amount is generally done in two installments. 

The first installment is released after the verification of documents and approval of the application. 

The second installment is disbursed after the completion of the academic year, contingent on maintaining attendance and academic performance. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Department of Welfare, Government of Jharkhand. 

The department is responsible for overseeing the application process and ensuring timely disbursement of funds. 

Students can contact the department for any queries or assistance regarding the scholarship. 

The contact details for the Department of Welfare can be found on the official government website. 

The scheme has seen a significant increase in the number of beneficiaries since its inception. 

In the academic year 2020-2021, over 50,000 students benefited from this scholarship. 

This represents a substantial increase from the previous years, indicating the scheme's effectiveness. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 100 crore for the financial year 2021-2022 for this scheme. 

This allocation reflects the commitment of the Jharkhand government towards enhancing educational opportunities for backward classes. 

The scholarship aims to empower students by reducing their financial burden. 

It encourages them to pursue higher education and improve their socio-economic status. 

The scheme also plays a crucial role in promoting social equity and inclusion in education. 

By supporting backward class students, the government aims to bridge the educational gap in the state. 

The scholarship scheme is a part of the larger initiative to uplift marginalized communities in Jharkhand. 

The government continuously monitors the implementation of the scheme to ensure transparency and efficiency. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the scheme further. 

The Jharkhand State Backward Classes Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme is a vital step towards achieving educational equity. 

It reflects the government's dedication to fostering an inclusive educational environment. 

Students are encouraged to apply early and ensure that all required documents are submitted. 

This will help in avoiding delays in the disbursement of scholarship funds. 

The scheme is expected to evolve with changing educational needs and economic conditions. 

Future enhancements may include increasing the scholarship amounts or expanding eligibility criteria. 

The government is committed to regularly reviewing the scheme's impact and making necessary adjustments. 

This ensures that it continues to meet the needs of the backward classes effectively. 

In conclusion, the Jharkhand State Backward Classes Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme is a significant initiative. 

It provides essential financial support to students from backward classes in Jharkhand. 

This support is crucial for promoting higher education and reducing dropout rates. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's efforts in fostering educational development and social justice. 

Students are encouraged to take advantage of this opportunity to further their education. 

By doing so, they can contribute positively to their communities and the state as a whole. 

The scheme not only benefits individual students but also strengthens the educational framework of Jharkhand. 

It is a vital resource for those seeking to improve their academic and professional prospects. 

Overall, the Jharkhand State Backward Classes Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme is a commendable effort by the government. 

It aims to empower the youth of Jharkhand and pave the way for a brighter future.
